Issue: The 2026-08-24 weekly export is a full re-run of the 2026-08-22 export (same 780 SRO/Line keys)
How detected: (SRO, Line) is unique inside every export; 780 keys appear twice, all second copies in the 08-24 export, identical to the 08-22 copy after cleaning
Rule applied: Keep one copy per (SRO, Line), from the latest export. The run stops if copies ever disagree

Issue: Branch typed 14 ways: case, padding spaces and full names ('riv', 'Riverton ', ' OAK', 'Elmwood')
Rule applied: upper(trim()) then an explicit alias table; an unknown spelling stops the run

How detected: Acct values that are not a plain 4-digit code
Rule applied: Trim and strip '.0' before matching rule 1

How detected: Pattern check. MM/DD proven: all 582 slash dates fall 0-9 days before their export, the same lag as ISO dates; read as DD/MM only 11 would
Rule applied: Parse ISO, then MM/DD/YYYY; an unparsed date stops the run

Issue: Rows dated outside Q3: June (in the 06-27 export) and October (in the October exports)
How detected: TransDate outside 2026-07-01..2026-09-30. No Q3-dated line arrived after the 30-Sep 18:00 export

Issue: Capitalized rebuild operations 75 and 100 on R&M accounts
Rule applied: Rule 2: every line on these operations excluded

Issue: Reversals (negative quantity); 8 reverse a line from the previous month
How detected: Qty < 0; all 60 matched to an original line on SRO, item, quantity and unit cost; same branch, operation and account
Rule applied: Rule 3: each line in the month of its own date, no netting

Issue: Possible double posting: pairs in the same export identical on SRO, operation, date, account, item, quantity and unit cost, differing only by Line
How detected: Group by every business field except Line. Same item in different SROs shares a unit cost only rarely, so 25 identical pairs are unlikely to be chance
Rule applied: Kept and flagged. Not a README rule, and Accounting's total includes them (the bridge closes only with them in). Ask the ERP-A owner to confirm

Issue: Subtotal rows inside the GL detail (JournalID 'SUBTOTAL', one per account and month)
How detected: JournalID = 'SUBTOTAL'; each checked equal to its detail lines (31/31)

Issue: AmountCAD stored as text with a thousands separator ('2,992.80')

Rule applied: Comma removed, cast to DECIMAL; a non-number stops the run

Issue: PostingDate is DD/MM/YYYY text (ERP-A is ISO or MM/DD)
How detected: First part reaches 31, second never exceeds 10: day-first is certain
Rule applied: Parse DD/MM/YYYY; an unparsed date stops the run
